items.description: Imports MJML markup into an EmailTemplateDocument. Parsing is XML-based with an mj-raw shim (raw content may be non-well-formed HTML), tolerates comments, preserves unknown elements as raw blocks and unknown attributes in ExtraAttributes, and never throws — failures are returned as ImportMessages.

members.name: Clone
members.description: Creates an independent deep copy of a block. Identifiers are preserved.

members.name: CloneWithNewIds
members.description: Creates an independent deep copy of a block with a fresh identifier on every node (used when pasting/duplicating so the copy does not collide with the original).

members.name: DeepClone
members.description: Creates an independent deep copy of the document. Identifiers are preserved.

items.description: Structural edit operations over an EmailTemplateDocument: finding, adding, moving, removing and duplicating blocks, sections and columns. All operations work across nested hero/group/wrapper containers via DocumentTree.

members.name: AddBlock
members.description: Inserts a block into the column with the given id at index (clamped). Returns false if no such column exists.

members.name: AddColumn
members.description: Adds a column to the section and rebalances all columns to equal widths.

members.name: AddSection
members.description: Inserts a top-level section at index (clamped).

members.name: DuplicateBlock
members.description: Inserts a deep copy (with fresh ids) of the block immediately after the original, in the same container. Returns the copy, or null if the block was not found.

members.name: DuplicateSection
members.description: Inserts a deep copy (with fresh ids) of a top-level section immediately after the original. Returns the copy, or null if the section was not found.

members.name: FindBlock
members.description: Finds a block anywhere in the document by id, or returns null.

members.name: FindParentColumn
members.description: Returns the column that directly contains the given block, or null when the block is held by a non-column container (e.g. a hero) or does not exist.

members.name: MoveBlock
members.description: Moves a block to the target column at targetIndex (clamped, evaluated after removal). Returns false if the block or target column is missing.

members.name: MoveSection
members.description: Moves a top-level section to index (clamped after removal).

members.name: RebalanceColumns
members.description: Sets every column in the section to an equal share of the width (summing to 100%).

members.name: RemoveBlock
members.description: Removes a block from wherever it lives in the tree. Returns whether it was found.

members.name: RemoveColumn
members.description: Removes a column by id and rebalances the remaining columns. Returns whether found.

members.name: RemoveSection
members.description: Removes a top-level section by id. Returns whether it was found.

items.description: Implemented by anything that directly holds a list of content blocks (a column or a hero). Used by the document tree operations to find, add, move and remove blocks uniformly.
Column-width arithmetic shared by section editing and layout presets.

members.description: Computes count equal column widths as percentage strings that always total exactly 100% (the last column absorbs any rounding remainder).

members.description: Formats a percentage value, trimming trailing zeros (e.g. 50%, 33.33%).

items.description: Models the MJML <mj-attributes> head section: global defaults (mj-all), per-component defaults and named classes (mj-class). The importer keeps this cascade intact rather than flattening it onto blocks, preserving both fidelity and editability of global styles.

members.name: Resolve
members.description: Resolves the head-level value of an attribute for a component, following MJML precedence: referenced classes (later class wins) > per-tag default > mj-all. Returns null when no head rule supplies the attribute (the block's own value or the MJML built-in default then applies). The block's own inline value is not considered here.

members.name: All
members.description: Gets the attributes applied to every component (mj-all).

members.name: Classes
members.description: Gets the named class definitions (mj-class), keyed by class name.

members.name: PerTag
members.description: Gets the per-component default attributes, keyed by MJML tag name (e.g. mj-text).

items.description: A single mj-html-attributes selector: a CSS path and the custom HTML attributes to apply. Carried for lossless round-trip; the default renderer (Mjml.Net) does not emit it (see E0.9).

members.name: Attributes

items.description: Validates a document for structural and content correctness: layout (via LayoutValidator) plus per-block rules such as required button hrefs and image sources/alt text. Findings carry localization keys, never localized text.

members.description: Validates the document and returns all findings (layout + block level).

items.description: Default render pipeline: Scriban substitution on subject/preheader, MJML generation + Scriban substitution (resolving variables and VisibleWhen conditions) + Mjml.Net compilation for the HTML, and a substituted plain-text version. Errors from every phase are aggregated in order.

Sanitizes the inline HTML allowed inside text-bearing blocks: only a small safe whitelist of tags and attributes survives; scripts/styles are dropped with their content, event handlers and unsafe URL schemes are stripped. Built on AngleSharp's HTML parser so it is robust against evasion.

members.name: Sanitize
members.description: Returns a sanitized copy of html safe to embed in generated markup.

items.description: Renders an EmailTemplateDocument with a data model into HTML and text.
Compiles MJML markup into responsive HTML.
The outcome of compiling MJML markup to HTML.

members.name: Errors

members.name: Html
members.description: The produced HTML (may be partial or empty when errors occurred).

members.name: Success
members.description: Gets whether compilation produced no errors.

items.description: Generates MJML markup from an EmailTemplateDocument. Default attribute values are omitted for clean output, attribute values are escaped, text-block HTML is sanitized, and a block's VisibleWhen wraps it in a Scriban condition.

members.name: Generate
members.description: Generates MJML for the document using the given options (render-safe by default).

members.name: ForExport
members.description: Options for producing MJML intended for export/round-trip (includes everything).

Thrown when an email template document cannot be (de)serialized — for example malformed JSON or an unknown block type discriminator. Carries a clear, surfaced message instead of crashing.

Serializes EmailTemplateDocument to and from JSON. Block polymorphism uses the type discriminator declared on EmailBlockBase. Unknown properties are ignored (forward compatibility); unknown block types and malformed JSON surface as EmailTemplateSerializationException.

members.name: Options

items.description: Extracts every template variable referenced anywhere in a document — subject, preheader, block content and URLs, visibility conditions and raw block content — as a merged, de-duplicated set.

items.description: Renders, validates and analyzes Scriban-syntax templates within a sandbox.

Converts an arbitrary model into a Scriban ScriptObject. Dictionaries become script objects keyed by their entries (so JSON-derived models work), lists are converted element-wise, and POCO/anonymous objects are imported with the default snake_case member renamer.

members.description: Builds a script object usable as the global scope for rendering.

members.description: Gets the error message (null when succeeded).

items.description: Generates a plausible sample data model from a template's extracted variables, so previews and the "fill from template" action produce realistic, fully-populated output.

items.description: A sandboxed ITemplateEngine built on Scriban. Rendering is bounded by TemplateSecurityOptions (loops, recursion, output size, time), include is disabled (no template loader) and no .NET reflection is exposed.

items.description: Sandbox limits applied when rendering user-authored templates, bounding loops, recursion, output size and wall-clock time so a malicious or buggy template cannot hang or exhaust memory.

members.name: LoopLimit
members.description: Maximum total loop iterations before rendering aborts (default 5000).

members.name: MaxOutputLength
members.description: Maximum length of the rendered output in characters (default 5,000,000).

members.name: RecursiveLimit
members.description: Maximum recursion depth before rendering aborts (default 100).

members.name: StrictVariables
members.description: When true, referencing an undefined variable is an error; otherwise it renders as empty (the default, lenient behaviour).

members.name: Timeout
members.description: Maximum wall-clock time for a single render (default 5 seconds, cooperative).

items.description: The result of validating a template's syntax.

members.name: SyntaxErrorKey
members.description: Localization key used for template syntax errors.

members.name: Invalid
members.description: Creates an invalid result with the given errors.

members.name: Errors
members.description: Gets the syntax errors found (empty when valid).

members.name: IsValid
members.description: Gets whether the template is syntactically valid.

members.name: Valid
members.description: A valid result.

items.description: Extracts the variable paths referenced by a template by walking the parsed AST. Loop variables are excluded automatically (they parse as locals, not globals); loop pseudo-objects (for, while…) are ignored explicitly. Both the full dotted path and its root are reported.

members.name: Extract
members.description: Returns the distinct variable paths referenced by the template (empty when it has syntax errors).

members.name: ExtractInfos
members.description: Returns the distinct variables referenced by the template, each marked as a scalar or a collection (when used as a for iterator). Empty when the template has syntax errors.

items.description: A variable referenced by a template, with its dotted path and inferred kind.

members.name: Kind
members.description: Whether the variable is iterated as a collection.

members.name: Path
members.description: The dotted variable path (e.g. user.address.city).

items.description: Whether a template variable is used as a single value or iterated as a collection.
